Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal

Sl. No Date Court'S Or Judges'S Orders
 directions and
 Registrar's order
 with Signatures
 Wpcrl No. 578 of 2024
 Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Mohd. Matlub, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. V.K. Gemini, learned Dy.A.G. along with Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. By the instant petition, the petitioner is praying for quashing the FIR No.0177 of 2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 376, 504 and 506 of IPC at Police Station Ramnagar,
District Nainital.

4. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that on perusal of the contents of the FIR, no offence is made out against the present petitioner under Section 376 and submits that as per the contents of the FIR only on the false pretext of marriage, the present petitioner has been implicated.

He further submits that the contents of the impugned FIR itself establish that the complainant was in relationship with the petitioner.
5.

Mr. V.K. Gemini, learned Dy.A.G for the State accepts notice on behalf of respondent nos.1 and 2.
6.
Learned counsel for the petitioner shall take steps to serve respondent no.3 within a week returnable within three weeks.
8. Respondents may file counter- affidavit within four weeks.
Two weeks' time thereafter is also granted to learned counsel for the petitioner to file rejoinder-affidavit.

After taking into consideration from the contents of the FIR prima facie it appears that the relation in between the petitioner and the accused were consensual, however, the investigation is WPCRL/578/2024 on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165712286/
1 going on, therefore at this stage, without giving any opinion on the merit of the case.

For an interim measure, the investigation pursuant to the FIR No.0177 of 2024 dated 18.05.2024, may go on,
however, the petitioner shall not be arrested provided he cooperates with the investigation.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 12.06.2024 R.Bisht WPCRL/578/2024 on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165712286/
2
